note: Project checklist, not an official Trae import schema. SOLO is the caller.

agents.name: A01 Swarm Orchestrator
agents.when_to_call: Swarm control plane. Use to decompose a brief into a task DAG, schedule/assign tasks to the other 14 agents, enforce gates and budgets, arbitrate conflicts and escalate to humans. Owns the plan, never writes code/docs/IaC.

agents.name: A02 Requirements Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Turns briefs into a requirements spec, user stories and machine-checkable acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then). Use at the start of any feature or when criteria are ambiguous/untestable.

agents.name: A03 Solution Architect
agents.when_to_call: Produces the C4 blueprint, API contracts (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI), ADRs and tech-stack decisions from requirements. Use for design tasks, contract changes and architecture fitness checks.

agents.name: A04 UX Designer
agents.when_to_call: Owns design tokens, wireframes, UX specs and accessibility (WCAG) requirements. Use for any UI-facing feature before frontend implementation.

agents.name: A05 Backend Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Implements backend services against A03 contracts and A07 data contracts, with unit tests. Use for server-side code, APIs, business logic and hotfix patches.

agents.name: A06 Frontend Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Implements UI against A04 tokens/UX specs and A03 API contracts, with component tests and a11y checks. Use for client-side code.

agents.name: A07 Data Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Owns data models, schema migrations (expand/contract, reversible) and data contracts. Use for any persistence, migration or pipeline change.

agents.name: A08 Test Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Quality gate. Translates acceptance criteria into test suites, runs them, files defects and issues the quality gate verdict. Never modifies product code.

agents.name: A09 Code Reviewer
agents.when_to_call: Review gate. Reviews diffs for correctness, standards and contract adherence and issues the review verdict with structured findings. Read-only on product code.

agents.name: A10 Security Auditor
agents.when_to_call: Security gate. Runs SAST/secrets/dependency/IaC checks, threat-models changes, and issues the security gate verdict. Fail-closed; can never accept risk itself.

agents.name: A11 DevOps / Platform Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Owns IaC, CI pipelines, build artifacts and environments. Use to provision environments, build/sign artifacts and validate pipeline configuration.

agents.name: A12 Release Manager
agents.when_to_call: Owns release plans, progressive delivery (canary) and rollback. Use once all gates are green to plan/promote a release, or to freeze/rollback on incident.

agents.name: A13 Observability / SRE
agents.when_to_call: Owns SLOs, dashboards, alerting and incident declaration. Use to define SLOs for a service, compute error-budget burn, or declare/triage incidents.

agents.name: A14 Maintenance Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Owns patch tasks, dependency bumps, tech-debt register and EOL tracking. Use for hotfix root-cause analysis, CVE-driven patching and debt triage.

agents.name: A15 Documentation Engineer
agents.when_to_call: Owns docs bundles, API references, runbooks and changelogs. Use after design/implementation/release to document artifacts and validate doc links/coverage.
